question: To whom must the sacred teaching never be given according to this prohibition?
premises: Slandering the Kula Bhairava is prohibited
inference: The teaching must not be given to a reviler of Shiva or a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava
plain_english: Not to one who reviles Shiva, O Goddess, nor to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
